instruction.name: vffint.d.l
instruction.description: Convert signed 64-bit integer elements in `a` to double-precision floating point numbers.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vffint.d.l $vr0, $vr8; vffint.d.l $vr1, $vr9; vffint.d.l $vr2, $vr10; vffint.d.l $vr3, $vr11; vffint.d.l $vr4, $vr12; vffint.d.l $vr5, $vr13; vffint.d.l $vr6, $vr14; vffint.d.l $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vffint.d.l $vr0, $vr8; vffint.d.l $vr1, $vr9; vffint.d.l $vr2, $vr10; vffint.d.l $vr3, $vr11; vffint.d.l $vr4, $vr12; vffint.d.l $vr5, $vr13; vffint.d.l $vr6, $vr14; vffint.d.l $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
